title: It's Halloween weekend
blurb: Halloween lands on Saturday, and Three Village is ready. Stony Brook Village throws its 36th annual Halloween Festival, Port Jeff's shops hand out treats all afternoon, and Benner's Farm runs haunted hayrides on Friday night.
short: The Stony Brook Village Halloween Festival, trick or treating in Port Jeff and haunted hayrides at Benner's Farm.
bullets_short: Sat 12-4 PM: 36th Annual Halloween Festival in Stony Brook Village, free: trick or treat through the shops, music, kids' games, and the scarecrow winner announced at 2 PM
Sat 11 AM-5 PM: Trick or Treat in Port Jefferson Village with the Greater Port Jefferson Chamber
Fri 6-9 PM: Haunted Evening Hayrides at Benner's Farm, East Setauket ($17, advance tickets only), plus every Halloween event on our Halloween page

cal.where: Stony Brook Village Center, 111 Main St, Stony Brook, NY

title: Remembering Snow Shed
blurb: This will be the first winter in 44 years without our local ski and snowboard experts. A look back at the little shop on Route 112 that got Long Island fitted, tuned and sent north.
